# contentful_app_definition (Resource)

Manages a Contentful App Definition: the app's name, hosting source, locations in the web app, and parameter definitions. Use `contentful_app_installation` to install it in an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploy the app separately and replace src with its HTTPS URL.
resource "contentful_app_definition" "this" {
  organization_id = var.contentful_organization_id

  name = "Editorial tools"
  src  = "https://app.example.com"

  locations = [
    { location = "app-config" },
    {
      location = "entry-field"
      field_types = [
        { type = "Symbol" },
        { type = "Link", link_type = "Entry" },
        { type = "Array", items = { type = "Symbol" } },
        { type = "Array", items = { type = "Link", link_type = "Asset" } },
      ]
    },
    {
      location        = "page"
      navigation_item = { name = "Editorial tools", path = "/editorial-tools" }
    },
  ]

  parameters = {
    installation = [
      {
        id      = "refreshInterval"
        name    = "Refresh interval"
        type    = "Number"
        default = jsonencode(42)
      },
      {
        id   = "accessToken"
        name = "Access Token"
        type = "Secret"
      },
    ]
    instance = [
      {
        id      = "theme"
        name    = "Theme"
        type    = "Enum"
        default = jsonencode("light")
        options = [jsonencode({ light = "Light" }), jsonencode({ dark = "Dark" })]
      },
    ]
  }
}
```

## Field types

An `entry-field` location declares which field types the app can edit. This does
not create content fields or select the app as their editor.

Contentful validates field types and link targets. Array item types are not
interchangeable with outer field types; for example, use `Symbol` or `Link` for
array items. ResourceLink and unfamiliar field types are left to Contentful to
validate, including their nested attributes. The provider can represent these
forms, but successful App Definition API support has not been established.

## Parameter values

Defaults are encoded as JSON. For Symbol, Number, Boolean, Enum, and Secret,
provide a JSON string, number, or boolean appropriate for the parameter type.
Omit `default` to leave it unspecified; JSON `null` is rejected.

Options may be omitted. For these types, a configured options list must be
nonempty. Each option must encode a nonempty JSON string or an object with exactly
one member, for example `{"light":"Light"}`.
The provider leaves identifier syntax and uniqueness, unfamiliar
parameter types, and instance Secret restrictions to Contentful.

Do not put real secrets in declaration defaults. A Secret declaration does not
establish secrecy or redaction guarantees for installed instance values.

## Validation limits

Values unknown during planning are checked before writing. Terraform can discard
misspelled nested keys before the provider receives them, so validation cannot detect
every typo. Use the documented snake_case attribute names.

## Updating existing definitions

Reads and imports preserve existing location and parameter values, including values that would
be invalid in a new request. Updates validate the complete planned locations and parameters,
including values retained by `ignore_changes`. An unrelated update can therefore
plan successfully and fail during apply before this definition is written to
Contentful. Other resources in the apply may already have changed.

Correct invalid values before updating the definition.
Configuration must still be valid, including when destroying the resource. If a
configuration error blocks destroy, correct the configuration and retry destroy;
that correction does not first need to be applied to Contentful.

## Schema

### Required

- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations where the app can be rendered in the Contentful web app. Use `[]` for no locations. Rendering locations require a frontend hosting source. When the provider sends a `src` URL, including one retained from state, Contentful requires at least one location other than `dialog`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `name` (String) A human-readable name of the app.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization that owns the app definition. Changing this value replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `bundle_id` (String) ID of an App Bundle belonging to this definition. Omission retains the selected bundle during in-place updates.
- `parameters` (Attributes) App configuration parameter definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `src` (String) Nonempty frontend URL using HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost. Omission retains the existing URL during in-place updates. Configure explicitly to retain it during replacement.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `app_definition_id` (String) System ID of the app definition.
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource identifier in `organization_id/app_definition_id` form.

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Required:

- `location` (String) Location identifier (e.g., entry-field, entry-sidebar, app-config).

Optional:

- `field_types` (Attributes List) Field types the app can edit at `entry-field` locations. At least one is required; omit for other locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations--field_types))
- `navigation_item` (Attributes) Navigation item for `page` locations; omit for other locations. Omission removes existing navigation configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations--navigation_item))

<a id="nestedatt--locations--field_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations.field_types`

Required:

- `type` (String) Field type (e.g., Symbol, Text, Integer, Link, Array).

Optional:

- `items` (Attributes) Required item type definition for `Array` fields. Omit for scalar and `Link` fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations--field_types--items))
- `link_type` (String) Type of linked resource. Required for `Link` fields; omit for scalar field types. For `Link`, use `Entry` or `Asset`. For linked array items, configure `items.link_type`. Contentful validates `ResourceLink` configuration; successful App Definition API support has not been established.

<a id="nestedatt--locations--field_types--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations.field_types.items`

Required:

- `type` (String) Array item type, such as `Symbol` or `Link`.

Optional:

- `link_type` (String) Type of linked resource. Required for `Link` items; omit for scalar item types. For `Link`, use `Entry` or `Asset`. Contentful validates `ResourceLink` configuration; successful App Definition API support has not been established.



<a id="nestedatt--locations--navigation_item"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations.navigation_item`

Required:

- `name` (String) Nonempty display name for the navigation item.
- `path` (String) Nonempty navigation path beginning with `/`, for example `/dashboard`.



<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Optional:

- `installation` (Attributes List) Parameter definitions for each app installation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters--installation))
- `instance` (Attributes List) Parameter definitions for each use of the app, such as a field editor. Maximum eight definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters--instance))

<a id="nestedatt--parameters--installation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters.installation`

Required:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the parameter.
- `name` (String) Display name for the parameter.
- `type` (String) Parameter type (e.g., Symbol, Enum, Boolean).

Optional:

- `default` (String) Default parameter value encoded as JSON. For Symbol, Number, Boolean, Enum, and Secret, provide a JSON string, number, or boolean appropriate for the parameter type. Omit this attribute to leave the default unspecified.
- `description` (String) Help text describing the parameter.
- `labels` (Attributes) Display labels for Boolean values and the empty Enum selection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters--installation--labels))
- `options` (List of String) Optional parameter choices, each encoded as JSON. For Symbol, Number, Boolean, Enum, and Secret, a configured list must be nonempty. Each option must encode a nonempty JSON string or an object with exactly one member. Omit this attribute to leave options unspecified.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether a parameter value must be provided.

Optional:

- `false` (String) Label for false value.

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Choose one of the following methods. Match the resource address and Contentful IDs to your configuration, then review the plan before applying.

### Import by identity

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) with `identity`:

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    organization_id   = var.contentful_organization_id
    app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id
  }
  to = contentful_app_definition.this
}
```

### Import by ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) with `id`:

```terraform
import {
  id = "${var.contentful_organization_id}/${var.app_definition_id}"
  to = contentful_app_definition.this
}
```

### Import with the CLI

Use the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import). Set the shell variables to your Contentful IDs before running it:

```shell
terraform import contentful_app_definition.this "$CONTENTFUL_ORGANIZATION_ID/$CONTENTFUL_APP_DEFINITION_ID"
```
